name: TimePicker
summary: Hours/minutes input + am/pm pill toggle on one row inside a field shell. Two narrow numeric inputs, a non-interactive colon separator, and a two-state segmented pill.

format.description: Defaults to user's locale (navigator.language). 12h shows the am/pm pill; 24h omits it.

keyboard: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight on pill — flip am ⇄ pm
Type two digits in HH — auto-advance to MM
Blur — auto-pad single digits to two ('9' → '09')
rules: HH gets aria-label='Hours'; MM gets aria-label='Minutes'.
inputMode='numeric' and maxLength=2 on each digit input.
am/pm pill uses role='radiogroup' with role='radio' segments and aria-checked.
Clamp HH on blur (0–23 for 24h, 1–12 for 12h); clamp MM to 0–59.

do: Auto-advance from HH to MM after two digits.
Default format to 12h or 24h based on navigator.language.
Use the segmented-style pill for am/pm — never a Select dropdown.
dont: Don't allow values like 99 minutes — clamp on blur.
Don't show am/pm in 24h locales — render conditionally on format='12h'.
Don't let the user type non-digits — filter on input.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. Two-numeric-input shell + two-state am/pm pill (segmented-style); locale-aware 12h vs 24h.
